names.description: Not a Terraform variable. Google fixes a gcr.io repository's name by its host, so this chart gives no cloud name and takes no key here (docs/design.md, "Names, labels and tags").

namePrefix.description: Optional convenience (not a Terraform variable). This chart gives no cloud name, so it changes nothing. A DNS label.

tags.description: Cloud labels on every resource (Google Cloud labels on the repository: lower-case letters, digits, _ and -).

iam.description: IAM bindings for the registry in {ROLE => [MEMBERS]} format. Artifact Registry roles; a Cloud Storage role is refused.

location.description: Registry location. Can be US, EU, ASIA or empty (gcr.io).

deletion_policy.description: Not a fabric variable: DELETE (default) or ABANDON. PREVENT has no Config Connector equivalent.
